comparison.objective: Remove a drawer by pressing two opposite-sense slide releases while pulling.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneously actuate two spatially separated levers and translate/support the drawer.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer clears both slides, rests flat and still on the table, and both grippers release; versions differ on whether lever history is directly scored.
comparison.reason: Simultaneous dual-release extraction is meaningfully different from sequential tool withdrawal, collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and damping tests.
